scenes.narrationEn: Fenrir treated Kadan like his own son. He united several tribes and was destroying the Northern Citadel of the Shadow Realm one by one.

scenes.narrationEn: It was believed that decades of oppression could be ended if only the last capital was captured. Kadan took the lead using the defensive tactics of the Ironforge strategic core. Before destroying the walls, he evacuated the inhabitants through underground waterways and froze the supply depot, forcing the garrison to surrender.
scenes.narrationKo: 마지막 수도만 점령하면 수십 년의 압박을 끝낼 수 있다고 믿었다. 카단은 아이언포지 전략 코어의 방어전술을 사용해 선봉을 맡았다. 그는 성벽을 부수기 전에 지하 수로로 주민을 빼내고, 보급 창고만 얼려 수비대가 항복하도록 만들었다.

scenes.narrationEn: The victory was slow, but fewer than half as many people died as in previous battles. At the end of each battle, he wrote down the number of enemy and friendly wounded in the same ledger.

scenes.narrationEn: Generals complained about the need to count the number of enemies. Kadan answered that it is not a ledger that calculates the strength to fight the next day, but a ledger that remembers the reasons why he could not stop today. The generals of Fenrir were frustrated.

scenes.narrationKo: 적을 살려 두면 다시 칼을 든다고 주장했다. 펜릴은 처음에는 카단의 방식을 허락했으나 전쟁이 길어질수록 더 빠른 승리를 원했다. 수도 공성전에서 루시안은 주민들을 성벽 위에 묶었다.

Moments when you overcame the opposition of someone close to you because something worse would happen if you didn't save them.

scenes.narrationEn: But I couldn't fake it for long. Fenrir's SS began arresting Freemen's League liaison soldiers. On the day the war was won, Kadan had to find a way to escape again from the country where he grew up.
